newsitem.title: USA: Conceptronic names Arthur Trudel CFO.
newsitem.headline: Conceptronic names Arthur Trudel CFO.

text.p: Conceptronic Inc said Monday it has hired Arthur Trudel as its chief financial officer.
Trudel will join the company April 14. Previously he was senior vice president and CFO with JHM Capital Corp.
The current CFO, Bill Gray, will stay with the company in another position.
The company also said that it will change its name to Arguss Holdings Inc, subject ot shareholder approval at its annual meeting, May 9.
Conceptronic is a manufacturer of highly advanced, computer-controlled capital equipment used in the electronic, SMT circuit assembly industry.
